chapter: Reading bands and the jazz scene
title: The contest against Celestin's band
summary: Handy recalls coming from Baton Rouge to play a contest against Celestin, won by Tup Johnson's band, and doubts it proved better.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: He had a good band. I had a good band.

Well, that's just like anything else. I don't know. They say Tup's won it, but I don't know. You take, uh, maybe that's because that was the first time they heard Tup's band. Everybody liked it. That didn't prove that they had a better band than Celestan. But, uh, first time hearing something, it sounds good to you. I imagine if they stayed around there three, four weeks or a month or so, they would have forgot about him. See you. But that particular one night stand, they go with people.
